title: CWP/14172/2023 of JASWINDER SINGH Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 254 CWP-14172-2023 (O & M) Date of decision: 18.02.2025 Jaswinder Singh ....Petitioner Versus State of Punjab and Others ...Respondents CORAM: HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE AMAN CHAUDHARY Present : Mr. A.K.Walia, Advocate, for the petitioner. Ms. Shruti, AAG, Punjab. AMAN CHAUDHARY, J. (ORAL)

1. Prayer made in the present petition is for quashing the order dated 30.06.2023, Annexure P-3, vide which the petitioner was transferred from Sub Jail, Patti to District Jail Mansa, which stayed by this Court on 07.07.2023.

2. Learned counsel, at the outset, submits that the petitioner would have no objection for being posted in the general transfers as per the policy, however till then, he may be allowed to continue at the present place of posting, which learned State counsel does not object.

3. Disposed of accordingly. The interim order shall continue only till the general transfers are carried out. 18.02.2025 (AMAN CHAUDHARY) parveen kumar JUDGE integrity of this order/judgment.

obligations.text: The interim order shall continue only till the general transfers are carried out.
obligations.action_summary: Maintain interim order staying transfer until general transfers are conducted
obligations.conditions: Until general transfers as per policy are carried out
